karen (Accounting): Heads up — BrightCompute sent INV-7890 dated 2026-03-28 for $5,480. No PO number on PDF. AP can't auto-match, putting on hold.
marie: can you upload the PDF?
karen (Accounting): uploaded INV-7890.pdf
samir (Procurement): checking PO history: `select po_id,amount,vendor from pos where vendor ilike '%brightcompute%'` -> PO-801201 for $4,800 (GPU rental) created 2025-12-02. amount mismatch of $680.
janelle (Eng Infra): what's the $680 for? extra hours?
brightcompute (vendor): we billed for 120 extra GPU-hours at $5.67/hr = $680 as per overage clause in SOW. SOW reference SOW-BC-2025-11 attached.
mira (FP&A): overage should have been pre-approved by eng with a usage alert; do we have a spend approval for overtime?
samir (Procurement): procurement has no ticket approving overtime. PO closed after initial commit.
karen (Accounting): AP policy: invoice >$5k requires PO match or manager approval. Without PO we escalate for approval or request corrected invoice referencing a PO.
marie: who can approve an OPEX overage for infra? janelle?
janelle (Eng Infra): I can approve one-off overage up to $2k. This is $680 over the PO, so i can approve if procurement creates a PO amendment or one-off PO line.
samir (Procurement): option A: ask vendor to re-issue invoice referencing PO-801201 and include line-level overage description; option B: create PO-801201-AMP (amendment) for $680 and attach approval, then AP can match. which do we prefer?
karen (Accounting): prefer vendor reissue to keep audit trail clean. but vendor reissue may take 3-5 business days. AP hold will last until then.
brightcompute (vendor): we can re-issue immediately with PO ref if you provide PO number to bill to.
marie: samir, can you confirm PO number to send?
samir (Procurement): send PO-801201 and request new invoice referencing it. i'll open vendor ticket now. ticket #V-1140: "Request re-issue INV-7890 referencing PO-801201; confirm overage qty and rate." cc: karen, janelle.
vendor-ops-bot: vendor ticket created V-1140 for brightcompute / INV-7890.
karen (Accounting): created payment hold HOLD-2072, reason: missing PO. due date on invoice 2026-04-27.
janelle (Eng Infra): ok i'm on standby to approve an amendment if vendor can't reissue by next Tue (2026-04-05).
mira (FP&A): FYI i need a quick note in Concur for budget reallocation if amendment >$500. samir, include GL and cost-center in ticket.
samir (Procurement): noted, adding GL 5400-ops, cost-center INFRA-ENG. sending to vendor now.
brightcompute (vendor): confirmed — will reissue by EOB today with PO-801201 in header. expect updated INV-7890-REV.
karen (Accounting): will remove hold and process on receipt of revised invoice.
marie: thanks everyone. I'll close this thread when AP marks paid. :white_check_mark:
